name: agentic-platforms-prd
title: Publish guardrails — agentic platforms PRD
summary: Prove Construct's path: procedure invoke returns a plan only, validate and publish fail on the thin stub, then pass on the golden fixture with styled PDF export.
systemOverlay: Demo mode for publish guardrails. Run the exact construct CLI commands from each step using shell or construct_tool. Do not hand-author production PRD markdown in chat — the passing artifact is tests/fixtures/publish/golden-prd-platform.md. The stub is tests/fixtures/publish/agentic-platforms-stub.md.

steps.title: Plan only — procedure invoke
steps.prompt: Run construct procedure invoke for prd-draft and show the specialist chain. This is plan-only — it does not draft the PRD.
steps.command: node bin/construct procedure invoke --json --workflow-type prd-draft --approval-mode proposal-only --text 'Enterprise agentic platform PRD'

steps.title: Release gate FAIL — thin stub
steps.prompt: Run artifact validate on the stub fixture with type prd-platform. It must fail (structure, visuals, citations).

steps.title: Publish FAIL — gate blocks distribution
steps.prompt: Run construct publish on the stub with --figures. Publish must exit 2 and block at the release gate.

steps.title: Golden fixture PASS — validate
steps.prompt: Run artifact validate on the golden prd-platform fixture. It must pass the release gate.

steps.title: Publish PASS — styled PDF
steps.prompt: Publish the golden fixture with --type=prd-platform --figures to .construct/publish/golden-prd-platform.pdf, then confirm the file exists.
